description: List current Bitcoin Runes balances per unspent output. Pass exactly one of address or outpoint. Keyless on OSS loopback; otherwise needs INSTANCE_TOKEN (OSS) or SECONDLAYER_API_KEY (hosted). Self-host needs the bitcoin compose profile. `notes` says when Runes is not configured.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_cursor

outpoint.description: Output as txid:vout. Exclusive with address.

rune.description: Narrow to one rune (id or name)

name: index_rune_balances
